mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_property_latest (device_id, identifier, data_type, value_text, reported_at) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{identifier}, #{dataType}, #{valueText}, #{reportedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE data_type = IF(#{reportedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} >= reported_at, #{dataType}, data_type), value_text = IF(#{reportedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} >= reported_at, #{valueText}, value_text), reported_at = IF(#{reportedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} >= reported_at, #{reportedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, reported_at)
